faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form, both soft copy and hard copy, is 24th August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an ITI certificate in Fitter, Machinist, Electrician, or Instrument Mechanic trade, or a Diploma in Mechanical, Metallurgical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Assistant post is 25 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Technical Assistant position is Rs. 17600 + 20% HRA per month for the first two years, and Rs. 22000 + 20% HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Technical Assistant in this recruitment drive by NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Assistant post will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Technical Assistant position at NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Institute of Technology Warangal, which is www.nitw.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the application form.
